findings.passage: Jodi cares deeply about restoring and protecting this trust. She will advocate for government transparency, fair maps, reducing unreasonable barriers for eligible voters, will support local election officials and call out misinformation for what it is. Jodi will be an advocate for any legislation that makes it easier for Wisconsinites to vote and will fight back against any attempts to reduce access to the ballot box.
findings.note: Campaign issues page for her 2024 Senate race, written in the third person. Says she would back reducing unreasonable barriers for eligible voters and legislation that makes voting easier. It does not mention ID.

findings.passage: In recent years, we have seen unfounded claims of election fraud, “anonymous objections” on controversial projects, voter suppression, and gerrymandered voting maps all undermine the public’s trust in our democracy.
findings.note: Same campaign page; describes unfounded fraud claims and voter suppression as harming trust in elections.
